[The Hacker News] Hackers Use Compromised ConnectWise Credential to Sign In to 173 Microsoft 365 Tenants — Cybersecurity researchers are sounding the alarm related to an active campaign in which unknown threat actors are abusing a compromised Microsoft 365 (M365) credential belonging to ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) to gain unauthorized access to customers' M365 environments.

ConnectWise Cloud Backup is a cloud-based backup and recovery service built for managed service providers

[Schneier on Security] The Future of AI Cryptanalysis — Matthew Green has been writing a rather pessimistic series of posts about the potential for AI systems to vastly outperform humans in cryptanalysis of both symmetric and public-key ciphers.
I am more optimistic than he is. That is, I have stronger faith in the over-engineering cryptographers tend to do. I am trying to write this up in more detail.
